preconditions.description: The length of string X is between 1 and 10^3.
The length of string Y is between 1 and 10^3.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in X) implies all(c.isupper() for c in Y)
preconditions.description: If all characters in X are lowercase, then all characters in Y must be uppercase.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() or c.islower() for c in X)
preconditions.description: Each character in X is either uppercase, lowercase, or both.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() or c.islower() for c in Y)
preconditions.description: Each character in Y is either uppercase, lowercase, or both.

postconditions.description: The output is 1 if it is possible to convert X to Y by making some lowercase letters uppercase and deleting all the lowercase letters, otherwise 0.
